name: Alzira (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the arms of Alzira, a lozenge of the bars of Aragon bearing a key.
history: The official flag of Alzira is of proportions 2:3, crimson, with the arms of the city occupying 45% of the width of the flag; it was approved by resolution of 29 September 2005 of the Conseller of Justice and Public Administrations and published in the DOGV. The arms are the traditional ones of immemorial use, showing the arms of the Kingdom of Valencia since it was a royal town, with the key alluding to its strategic position where the army of James I crossed the river Xúquer; they were rehabilitated by resolution of 17 February 1992.
